dormant_rule: candidate with zero observed pair-state support across all six pairs is DORMANT and cannot enter promoted Top-N; otherwise WARM
lightning_score: global_mean + sum(shrunk marginal effects) + mean(weighted shrunk pair residuals over six pairs)
marginal_shrinkage: n/(n+lambda_main), lambda_main = median support across observed position-state cells
pair_shrinkage: n/(n+lambda_pair), lambda_pair = median support across observed position-pair-state cells
random_baseline: SHA256 variant lexical hash ascending; no outcome information
relative_resonance_weight: abs(2*empirical_percentile(pair_residual)-1); preserves residual sign and downweights near-median interactions
ridge_baseline: one-hot of 4 position states + 6 pair-state tokens; RidgeCV alphas=logspace(-4,4,17), 5-fold deterministic KFold(shuffle=True, random_state=161)
